plan_dispositions.assessment: Adding confinement to bare child processes is warranted. Declared artifacts and OS defense are sensible conditions. plan_dispositions.clause: P2: Pass the dataset path and output directory as arguments.
plan_dispositions.candidate_disposition: Rejected as written, corrected in intent
plan_dispositions.assessment: Bounded pipes are viable, as is the retained preopened-directory option. Rejection of every confined path string on an authority-grant premise is false (F04). The optional UI/network pattern needs its Figma exception (F06).

plan_dispositions.clause: P3: A timeout limits each extension.
plan_dispositions.assessment: Memory/output budgets and cancellation meaningfully extend the timeout. Seconds and bytes are stated; illustrative magnitudes are not represented as measured defaults. Runtime callback existence is not an independently executed limit proof. T0 regex timeout scope remains under F01.

plan_dispositions.clause: P4: Store output as the new dataset after success.
plan_dispositions.assessment: Schema validation, provenance, log positions, replay comparison and snapshots carry undo/reproducibility intent. Critic-attributed C1/C2 improve the contract. Matching a bounded preview to the full commit and non-replayable-success exception remain design limitations. Source operation recipes do not themselves describe OpenRefine undo mechanics (m01).

plan_dispositions.clause: P5: Load the newest extension version automatically.

plan_dispositions.assessment: Rejection is justified by reproducibility of historical operations, with update checks distinguished from swaps and a host security-update path retained. Zotero compatibility/lifecycle and the OpenRefine release chain are useful evidence; claiming they categorically prohibit automatic updates overreads the guide (m02).
